name: Innocent Hearts -Hitotsu ni Naritai-
original_name: innocent hearts －ひとつになりたい－
source:
Unknown sealed letter arrives. It only contains a travel ticket for one person with the destination being the place protagonist's only childhood friend went out for a trip. A rural town visited only once. What's the truth about this invitation?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-june-2002-kanade.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
未知的密封信件到达。里面只有一张一人的旅行票，目的地是主角唯一的儿时好友出去旅行的地方。一个乡村小镇只去过一次。这份邀请的真相是什么？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-june-2002-kanade.html]vndbreview[/url]]
